description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldDateTime class, a specialized widget class for handling date and time fields within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework, including methods for filtering, querying, date expansion, and display formatting.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldDateTime
classes.description: A widget class for handling date/time fields, including querying and display functionalities specific to date/time data types within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getAssignedUser
methods.description: Retrieves the assigned user object based on the report definition string.

methods.name: queryFilterOn
methods.description: Creates a filter query based on a date input, handling presence or absence of time component.

methods.name: expandDate
methods.description: Converts a date string to include time, handling macros like 'today' and whether to set start or end of the day.

methods.name: queryFilterBefore
methods.description: Filters records before a specified date.

methods.name: queryFilterAfter
methods.description: Filters records after a specified date.

methods.name: queryFilterBetween_Dates
methods.description: Filters records between two dates.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Equals_str
methods.description: Filters records not matching a specified date/time string.

methods.name: get_users_current_date_time
methods.description: Returns the current user's date and time, optionally as a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: get_db_date
methods.description: Returns a date adjusted by a number of days with specific time flags ('start', 'end').

methods.name: get_start_end_date_filter
methods.description: Generates SQL filter conditions for date range filtering.

methods.name: queryDateOp
methods.description: Creates a SQL comparison operation for dates, converting DateTime objects as needed.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current date/time in the user's timezone.

methods.name: queryDay
methods.description: Creates a date filter query for a full day.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_yesterday
methods.description: Filters records for yesterday.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_today
methods.description: Filters records for today.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_tomorrow
methods.description: Filters records for tomorrow.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_last_7_days
methods.description: Filters records for the last 7 days.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_next_7_days
methods.description: Filters records for the upcoming 7 days.

methods.name: queryMonth
methods.description: Creates a SQL filter for a specific month.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_last_month
methods.description: Filters records for last month.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_this_month
methods.description: Filters records for the current month.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_next_month
methods.description: Filters records for the next month.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_last_30_days
methods.description: Filters records for the last 30 days.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_next_30_days
methods.description: Filters records for the next 30 days.

methods.name: getQuarterFilter
methods.description: Generates a filter query for a specific quarter, allowing modifications for previous/next quarter.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_last_quarter
methods.description: Filters records for the last quarter.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_this_quarter
methods.description: Filters records for the current quarter.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_next_quarter
methods.description: Filters records for the next quarter.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_last_year
methods.description: Filters records for last year.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_this_year
methods.description: Filters records for the current year.

methods.name: queryFilterTP_next_year
methods.description: Filters records for the next year.

methods.name: queryGroupBy
methods.description: Generates SQL for grouping by date/time components.

methods.name: queryOrderBy
methods.description: Generates SQL for ordering by date/time components.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Displays list representation of the date/time field.

methods.name: get_time_part
methods.description: Extracts the time part from a date/time string.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Displays the date/time in user-friendly format.

methods.name: querySelect
methods.description: Generates SQL select clause for the field.

methods.name: displayListday
methods.description: Returns list display for day.

methods.name: displayListyear
methods.description: Returns list display for year.

methods.name: displayListmonth
methods.description: Returns list display for month.

methods.name: querySelectmonth
methods.description: Generates SQL for month-level grouping.

methods.name: queryGroupByMonth
methods.description: Generates SQL for grouping by month.

methods.name: queryOrderByMonth
methods.description: Generates SQL for ordering by month.

methods.name: querySelectday
methods.description: Generates SQL for day-level grouping.

methods.name: queryGroupByDay
methods.description: Generates SQL for grouping by day.

methods.name: querySelectyear
methods.description: Generates SQL for year-level grouping.

methods.name: queryGroupByYear
methods.description: Generates SQL for grouping by year.

methods.name: querySelectquarter
methods.description: Generates SQL for quarter-level grouping.

methods.name: displayListquarter
methods.description: Displays quarter in QX YYYY format.

methods.name: queryGroupByQuarter
methods.description: Generates SQL grouping for quarters.
